title: Configure Defender cloud protection
description: Enable or configure Windows Defender cloud protection (analysis in the Microsoft cloud).

examples.description: Enable advanced cloud protection (recommended, better detection)
Enable basic cloud protection (less data sent)
Configure the automatic submission of suspicious samples (0=Ask, 1=Send safe ones, 2=Never, 3=Always)
Check the current cloud protection settings
Configure optimal cloud protection (advanced reporting + safe sample submission)

notes: MAPSReporting (Microsoft Active Protection Service): 0=Off, 1=Basic, 2=Advanced. Advanced is recommended: better detection of zero-day threats thanks to cloud analysis. SubmitSamplesConsent: 0=Always ask, 1=Send safe samples automatically, 2=Never send, 3=Send everything automatically.

fr.title: Configurer la protection cloud Defender
fr.description: Active ou configure la protection cloud de Windows Defender (analyse dans le cloud Microsoft).
fr.notes: MAPSReporting (Microsoft Active Protection Service): 0=Off, 1=Basic, 2=Advanced. Advanced recommandé: meilleure détection des menaces zero-day grâce à l'analyse cloud. SubmitSamplesConsent: 0=Toujours demander, 1=Envoyer échantillons sûrs auto, 2=Ne jamais envoyer, 3=Tout envoyer auto.

examples.Set-MpPreference -MAPSReporting 2: Active la protection cloud avancée (recommandé - meilleure détection)
examples.Set-MpPreference -MAPSReporting 1: Active la protection cloud basique (moins de données envoyées)
examples.Set-MpPreference -MAPSReporting 0: Désactive la protection cloud (réduit la sécurité!)
examples.Set-MpPreference -SubmitSamplesConsent 2: Configure l'envoi automatique des échantillons suspects (0=Demander, 1=Envoyer sûrs, 2=Jamais, 3=Toujours)
examples.Get-MpComputerStatus | Select-Object MAP: Vérifie les paramètres actuels de protection cloud
examples.Set-MpPreference -MAPSReporting 2 -Submi: Configure protection cloud optimale (reporting avancé + envoi échantillons sûrs)
